[[File:CorellianColonizerShip-TJP.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Corellian Colonizer praxeum ship]]

'''Praxeum ships''' also called '''Jedi training vessel''', were large [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that served as mobile [[Jedi academy|Jedi academies]].

The most notable example of a praxeum ship was the ''[[Chu'unthor]]'', which crash-landed on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in [[340 BBY]],<ref name="CoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> though other examples from the era of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], and even the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] and earlier are known to have existed, such as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Arca Jeth]]'s ''[[SunGem]]''.<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
